desc.en: Small fleshy muscle on the lateral dorsum of the foot, felt as a soft bulge in front of the lateral malleolus when the toes are extended. Its three tendons join the long extensor tendons of the second to fourth toes.
desc.id: Otot kecil berdaging di bagian lateral punggung kaki, teraba sebagai tonjolan lunak di depan malleolus lateralis saat jari-jari diekstensikan. Ketiga tendonya bergabung dengan tendo m. extensor digitorum longus untuk jari II-IV.

origin.la: Facies superolateralis calcanei (fundus sinus tarsi) et radix retinaculi musculorum extensorum inferioris
origin.en: Superolateral surface of the calcaneus in the floor of the tarsal sinus, and the stem of the inferior extensor retinaculum

insertion.la: Tendines musculi extensoris digitorum longi digitorum II-IV (aponeuroses dorsales)
insertion.en: Lateral sides of the long extensor tendons of the second to fourth toes

action.en: Helps extensor digitorum longus extend the second to fourth toes at the metatarsophalangeal and interphalangeal joints.
action.id: Membantu m. extensor digitorum longus melakukan ekstensi jari II-IV pada sendi metatarsophalangea dan interphalangea.

insertion: Tendines musculi extensoris digitorum longi II-IV
tendo m. extensor digitorum longus jari II-IV

desc.en: Medial part of the short extensor mass on the dorsum of the foot, often described as part of extensor digitorum brevis. Its tendon runs to the great toe on the lateral side of the extensor hallucis longus tendon.
desc.id: Bagian medial massa ekstensor pendek di punggung kaki, sering dianggap sebagai bagian m. extensor digitorum brevis. Tendonya menuju ibu jari kaki di sisi lateral tendo m. extensor hallucis longus.

origin.la: Facies superolateralis calcanei (cum musculo extensore digitorum brevi)
origin.en: Superolateral surface of the calcaneus, in common with extensor digitorum brevis

insertion.la: Facies dorsalis basis phalangis proximalis hallucis
insertion.en: Dorsal surface of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe

action.en: Extends the great toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
action.id: Ekstensi ibu jari kaki pada sendi metatarsophalangea.

desc.en: Superficial muscle along the medial border of the sole, forming the soft medial edge of the foot. The plantar vessels and nerves enter the sole deep to its upper end, under the flexor retinaculum.
desc.id: Otot superfisial di sepanjang tepi medial telapak kaki yang membentuk tepi medial kaki yang lunak. Vasa dan nervi plantares masuk ke telapak kaki di bawah ujung atasnya, di bawah retinaculum musculorum flexorum.

origin.la: Processus medialis tuberis calcanei, retinaculum musculorum flexorum et aponeurosis plantaris
origin.en: Medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity, flexor retinaculum and plantar aponeurosis

insertion.la: Latus mediale basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (cum capite mediali musculi flexoris hallucis brevis)
insertion.en: Medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, together with the medial head of flexor hallucis brevis

action.en: Abducts the great toe and helps flex it at the metatarsophalangeal joint; it supports the medial longitudinal arch.
action.id: Abduksi ibu jari kaki dan membantu fleksinya pada sendi metatarsophalangea; menopang arcus longitudinalis medialis.

desc.en: Central muscle of the first layer of the sole, lying directly under the plantar aponeurosis. Its four tendons split near the proximal phalanges to let the flexor digitorum longus tendons through, as the superficial flexor does in the hand.
desc.id: Otot di bagian tengah lapisan pertama telapak kaki, tepat di bawah aponeurosis plantaris. Keempat tendonya bercabang dekat phalanx proximalis sehingga tendo m. flexor digitorum longus dapat lewat di antaranya, seperti m. flexor digitorum superficialis di tangan.

origin.la: Processus medialis tuberis calcanei, aponeurosis plantaris et septa intermuscularia
origin.en: Medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity, plantar aponeurosis and intermuscular septa

insertion.en: Both sides of the middle phalanges of the lateral four toes

action.en: Flexes the lateral four toes at the proximal interphalangeal joints.
action.id: Fleksi jari kaki II-V pada sendi interphalangea proximalis.

note.en: The module puts it under 'kompartemen intermedial (lapisan dalam telapak kaki)'. It does lie in the central compartment, but it belongs to the first, most superficial layer of the sole.
note.id: Modul menempatkannya pada 'kompartemen intermedial (lapisan dalam telapak kaki)'. Otot ini memang berada di kompartemen sentral, tetapi termasuk lapisan pertama telapak kaki yang paling superfisial.

origin: Processus medialis tuberis calcanei et aponeurosis plantaris
action: fleksi jari II-V pada sendi PIP

desc.en: Superficial muscle along the lateral border of the sole, forming the lateral edge of the foot. It runs from the calcaneal tuberosity to the base of the little toe.
desc.id: Otot superfisial di sepanjang tepi lateral telapak kaki yang membentuk tepi lateral kaki. Otot ini berjalan dari tuber calcanei ke basis jari kelingking kaki.

origin.la: Processus medialis et lateralis tuberis calcanei, aponeurosis plantaris et septa intermuscularia
origin.en: Medial and lateral processes of the calcaneal tuberosity, plantar aponeurosis and intermuscular septa

insertion.la: Latus laterale basis phalangis proximalis digiti minimi
insertion.en: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the fifth toe

action.en: Abducts and flexes the little toe and supports the lateral longitudinal arch.
action.id: Abduksi dan fleksi jari kelingking kaki serta menopang arcus longitudinalis lateralis.

insertion: Basis phalangis proximalis digiti minimi (latus laterale)

desc.en: Flat quadrangular muscle in the second layer of the sole. It arises by two heads from the calcaneus and attaches to the lateral border of the flexor digitorum longus tendon, straightening the oblique pull of that tendon so the toes flex in line with the foot.
desc.id: Otot pipih segiempat di lapisan kedua telapak kaki. Otot ini berorigo dengan dua kepala dari calcaneus dan melekat pada tepi lateral tendo m. flexor digitorum longus, sehingga meluruskan tarikan miring tendo tersebut dan jari-jari kaki menekuk searah sumbu kaki.

origin.la: Facies medialis et margo lateralis faciei plantaris calcanei
origin.en: Medial surface and lateral margin of the plantar surface of the calcaneus

insertion.la: Margo posterolateralis tendinis musculi flexoris digitorum longi
insertion.en: Posterolateral margin of the flexor digitorum longus tendon

action.en: Corrects the oblique pull of flexor digitorum longus and so helps flex the lateral four toes.
action.id: Meluruskan tarikan miring m. flexor digitorum longus sehingga membantu fleksi jari kaki II-V.

action: meluruskan tarikan m. flexor digitorum longus

desc.en: Four small worm-like muscles in the second layer of the sole, arising from the tendons of flexor digitorum longus. Each passes along the medial side of one of the lateral four toes to its dorsal extensor expansion.
desc.id: Empat otot kecil berbentuk cacing di lapisan kedua telapak kaki yang berorigo dari tendo-tendo m. flexor digitorum longus. Masing-masing berjalan di sisi medial salah satu jari II-V menuju aponeurosis dorsalis jari tersebut.

origin.en: Tendons of flexor digitorum longus: the first from the medial side of the first tendon, the other three from adjacent tendons

insertion.la: Latus mediale aponeurosium dorsalium digitorum II-V
insertion.en: Medial side of the extensor expansions over the lateral four toes

action.en: Flex the metatarsophalangeal joints and extend the interphalangeal joints of the lateral four toes, which keeps the toes from buckling at push-off.
action.id: Fleksi sendi metatarsophalangea dan ekstensi sendi interphalangea jari II-V, sehingga jari-jari tidak tertekuk saat menolak.

nerve.la: Primus: nervus plantaris medialis; secundus ad quartum: nervus plantaris lateralis (ramus profundus)

insertion: falang proksimal jari II-V (via aponeurosis extensor)
nerve: n. plantaris medialis (I) dan n. plantaris lateralis (II-IV)
action: Flexio articulationum metatarsophalangearum et extensio articulationum interphalangearum
fleksi MTP dan ekstensi IP jari II-V

desc.en: Two-headed muscle in the third layer of the sole, lying along the first metatarsal. Each head ends on one side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe with a sesamoid bone in its tendon, and the flexor hallucis longus tendon runs between them.
desc.id: Otot berkepala dua di lapisan ketiga telapak kaki yang terletak di sepanjang os metatarsi I. Tiap kepala berinsersio pada satu sisi basis phalanx proximalis ibu jari kaki dengan sebuah os sesamoideum di dalam tendonya, dan tendo m. flexor hallucis longus berjalan di antara keduanya.

origin.la: Facies plantaris ossis cuboidei et ossis cuneiformis lateralis
origin.en: Plantar surfaces of the cuboid and lateral cuneiform

insertion.la: Latera basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (per ossa sesamoidea)
insertion.en: Both sides of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, through the two sesamoid bones

action.en: Flexes the proximal phalanx of the great toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx proximalis ibu jari kaki pada sendi metatarsophalangea.

origin: Os cuboideum et os cuneiforme laterale
insertion: Basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (per ossa sesamoidea)
action: fleksi ibu jari kaki pada sendi MTP

la: Caput mediale musculi flexoris hallucis brevis
alt: Caput mediale m. flexoris hallucis brevis
en: Medial head of flexor hallucis brevis

desc.en: Medial head of flexor hallucis brevis. It blends with the abductor hallucis tendon and reaches the medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe through the medial sesamoid.
desc.id: Kepala medial m. flexor hallucis brevis. Kepala ini menyatu dengan tendo m. abductor hallucis dan berinsersio pada sisi medial basis phalanx proximalis ibu jari kaki melalui os sesamoideum medial.

origin.la: Os cuboideum et os cuneiforme laterale (origo communis)
origin.en: Common origin from the cuboid and lateral cuneiform

insertion.la: Latus mediale basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (per os sesamoideum mediale)
insertion.en: Medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, through the medial sesamoid

la: Caput laterale musculi flexoris hallucis brevis
alt: Caput laterale m. flexoris hallucis brevis
en: Lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis

desc.en: Lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis. It blends with the adductor hallucis tendon and reaches the lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe through the lateral sesamoid.
desc.id: Kepala lateral m. flexor hallucis brevis. Kepala ini menyatu dengan tendo m. adductor hallucis dan berinsersio pada sisi lateral basis phalanx proximalis ibu jari kaki melalui os sesamoideum lateral.

origin.la: Os cuboideum et os cuneiforme laterale (origo communis)
origin.en: Common origin from the cuboid and lateral cuneiform

insertion.la: Latus laterale basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (per os sesamoideum laterale)
insertion.en: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, through the lateral sesamoid

desc.en: Muscle of the third layer of the sole with two heads: a large oblique head running forward from the bases of the middle metatarsals and a slender transverse head crossing the sole under the heads of the lateral metatarsals. Both end on the lateral side of the great toe.
desc.id: Otot lapisan ketiga telapak kaki dengan dua kepala: caput obliquum yang besar, berjalan ke depan dari basis ossa metatarsi bagian tengah, dan caput transversum yang ramping, menyilang telapak kaki di bawah caput ossa metatarsi lateral. Keduanya berinsersio pada sisi lateral ibu jari kaki.

origin.la: Caput obliquum: bases ossium metatarsi II-IV; caput transversum: ligamenta plantaria articulationum metatarsophalangearum III-V
origin.en: Oblique head: bases of the second to fourth metatarsals. Transverse head: plantar ligaments of the third to fifth metatarsophalangeal joints.

insertion.la: Latus laterale basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (cum capite laterali musculi flexoris hallucis brevis)
insertion.en: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, through the lateral sesamoid

action.en: Adducts the great toe toward the second toe and helps flex it; the transverse head helps hold the transverse arch.
action.id: Adduksi ibu jari kaki ke arah jari II dan membantu fleksinya; caput transversum membantu mempertahankan arcus transversus.

origin: Bases ossium metatarsi II-IV et ligamenta plantaria articulationum metatarsophalangearum
caput obliquum: basis metatarsal II-IV; caput transversum: ligamentum MTP III-V

desc.en: Large, thick head of adductor hallucis that runs obliquely forward and medially from the bases of the second to fourth metatarsals and the sheath of the fibularis longus tendon.
desc.id: Kepala m. adductor hallucis yang besar dan tebal, berjalan miring ke depan dan medial dari basis ossa metatarsi II-IV serta selubung tendo m. fibularis longus.

origin.la: Bases ossium metatarsi II-IV et vagina tendinis musculi fibularis longi
origin.en: Bases of the second to fourth metatarsals and the sheath of the fibularis longus tendon

insertion.la: Latus laterale basis phalangis proximalis hallucis
insertion.en: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe

desc.en: Thin flat head of adductor hallucis that crosses the sole beneath the heads of the third to fifth metatarsals and joins the oblique head. It helps keep the metatarsal heads together.
desc.id: Kepala m. adductor hallucis yang tipis dan pipih, menyilang telapak kaki di bawah caput ossa metatarsi III-V lalu bergabung dengan caput obliquum. Kepala ini membantu menahan caput ossa metatarsi agar tetap berdekatan.

origin.la: Ligamenta plantaria articulationum metatarsophalangearum III-V et ligamentum metatarsale transversum profundum
origin.en: Plantar ligaments of the third to fifth metatarsophalangeal joints and the deep transverse metatarsal ligament

insertion.la: Latus laterale basis phalangis proximalis hallucis
insertion.en: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe

la: Musculus flexor digiti minimi brevis pedis
alt: M. flexor digiti minimi brevis pedis
en: Flexor digiti minimi brevis of foot

desc.en: Small muscle of the third layer lying along the plantar surface of the fifth metatarsal, medial to abductor digiti minimi.
desc.id: Otot kecil lapisan ketiga yang terletak di sepanjang permukaan plantar os metatarsi V, di medial m. abductor digiti minimi.

origin.la: Basis ossis metatarsi V et vagina tendinis musculi fibularis longi
origin.en: Base of the fifth metatarsal and the sheath of the fibularis longus tendon

insertion.en: Base of the proximal phalanx of the fifth toe

action.en: Flexes the proximal phalanx of the little toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx proximalis jari kelingking kaki pada sendi metatarsophalangea.

origin: basis metatarsal V dan os cuboideum
action: fleksi jari V pada sendi MTP

desc.en: Small, inconstant slip of flexor digiti minimi brevis that inserts on the fifth metatarsal. True opposition is not possible in the foot; the muscle only pulls the fifth metatarsal toward the sole.
desc.id: Berkas kecil m. flexor digiti minimi brevis yang tidak selalu ada dan berinsersio pada os metatarsi V. Gerakan oposisi sejati tidak terjadi di kaki; otot ini hanya menarik os metatarsi V ke arah plantar.

origin.la: Ligamentum plantare longum et vagina tendinis musculi fibularis longi
origin.en: Long plantar ligament and the sheath of the fibularis longus tendon

insertion.en: Lateral border of the fifth metatarsal

action.en: Pulls the fifth metatarsal toward the sole and slightly medially.
action.id: Menarik os metatarsi V ke arah plantar dan sedikit ke medial.

note.en: The module gives the origin as the base of the fifth metatarsal. Most references describe it arising with flexor digiti minimi brevis from the long plantar ligament and the fibularis longus sheath; Moore treats it as part of that muscle.
note.id: Modul menulis origo pada basis os metatarsi V. Sebagian besar buku acuan menyebut otot ini berorigo bersama m. flexor digiti minimi brevis dari ligamentum plantare longum dan selubung tendo m. fibularis longus; Moore menganggapnya bagian dari otot tersebut.

action: menarik metatarsal V ke arah plantar

desc.en: Three unipennate muscles in the fourth (deepest) layer of the sole, each arising from the medial side of the third, fourth or fifth metatarsal. They adduct these toes toward the axis of the foot, which runs through the second toe (PAD: plantar adduct).
desc.id: Tiga otot unipennatus di lapisan keempat (terdalam) telapak kaki, masing-masing berorigo dari sisi medial os metatarsi III, IV atau V. Otot-otot ini melakukan adduksi jari III-V ke arah sumbu kaki yang melalui jari II (PAD: plantar adduksi).

origin.la: Bases et latera medialia ossium metatarsi III-V
origin.en: Bases and medial sides of the third to fifth metatarsals

insertion.la: Latera medialia basium phalangum proximalium digitorum III-V
insertion.en: Medial sides of the bases of the proximal phalanges of the third to fifth toes

action.en: Adduct the third to fifth toes toward the second toe and flex them at the metatarsophalangeal joints.
action.id: Adduksi jari III-V ke arah jari II dan fleksi pada sendi metatarsophalangea.

insertion: Bases phalangum proximalium digitorum III-V (latus mediale)

desc.en: Four bipennate muscles filling the spaces between the metatarsals, counted with the deepest layer of the sole. They abduct the toes away from the axis through the second toe (DAB: dorsal abduct); the second toe has one on each side, so it can move either way.
desc.id: Empat otot bipennatus yang mengisi celah di antara ossa metatarsi dan dihitung sebagai lapisan terdalam telapak kaki. Otot-otot ini melakukan abduksi jari menjauhi sumbu yang melalui jari II (DAB: dorsal abduksi); jari II memiliki satu interosseus dorsalis di tiap sisinya sehingga dapat digerakkan ke dua arah.

origin.en: Adjacent sides of the first to fifth metatarsals

insertion.la: Bases phalangum proximalium: primus latus mediale digiti II, secundus ad quartum latera lateralia digitorum II-IV; aponeuroses dorsales
insertion.en: Bases of the proximal phalanges: the first on the medial side of the second toe, the second to fourth on the lateral sides of the second to fourth toes; also the extensor expansions

action.en: Abduct the second to fourth toes from the axis through the second toe and flex them at the metatarsophalangeal joints.
action.id: Abduksi jari II-IV menjauhi sumbu yang melalui jari II dan fleksi pada sendi metatarsophalangea.
